definitions.explanation: A company that owns a controlling interest in one or more subsidiary companies. The metaphor of 'parent' (親) mirrors the English term.

examples.japanese: {親会社|おやがいしゃ}の{方針|ほうしん}に{従|したが}う。
examples.english: To follow the parent company's policy.

examples.japanese: {親会社|おやがいしゃ}から{資金|しきん}を{調達|ちょうたつ}した。
examples.english: We procured funds from the parent company.

examples.japanese: {親会社|おやがいしゃ}の{業績|ぎょうせき}が{悪化|あっか}すると、{子会社|こがいしゃ}にも{影響|えいきょう}が{出|で}る。
examples.english: When the parent company's performance worsens, the subsidiaries are affected too.

notes:
Compound of {親|おや} (parent) and {会社|かいしゃ} (company). A standard business term referring to a company that controls one or more other companies through ownership of shares.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {親会社|おやがいしゃ}の{方針|ほうしん} — parent company's policy
- {親会社|おやがいしゃ}の{指示|しじ} — instructions from the parent company
- {親会社|おやがいしゃ}と{子会社|こがいしゃ} — parent and subsidiary companies

RELATED WORDS:
- {子会社|こがいしゃ} — subsidiary company
- {関連会社|かんれんがいしゃ} — affiliated company; associated company
- {持株会社|もちかぶがいしゃ} — holding company
- {グループ会社|ぐるーぷがいしゃ} — group company
